# Admission Functions

Implements general participant admission during the Documents lifecycle. Candidate checks preserve source/origin identity, party mapping, source-reader scope and access requirements. Admission tokens bind the requested parties and Activation revision; a stale token requires reapproval rather than bypassing current-state validation. An authorized grant is recorded through the admission ledger, and each incoming party must explicitly consent; a decline records `admission_denied`.

The installer registers consent operations and requests access when needed. Installation becomes ready only for the current token revision, affirmative consents and access coverage of the expanded roster and existing readers. `finishAdmission` requires `installing` and roster coverage, retains the admitted revision, moves the entry to `linking` and emits admission progress with status `admitted`.

This does not by itself commercially activate the host or authorize later provision of a roster that violates another parent's prepared requirement. No admitted-terms witness is produced. Queue, retirement and rebase handling remain part of ordinary admission.
